summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting termination of its Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC, effective August 15, 2026. The at-the-market offering agreement, originally dated April 1, 2025 and amended April 10, 2026, allowed sales of common stock; through July 31, 2026, about 3.2 million shares were sold for roughly $2.8 million gross. No penalties apply, and no further sales will occur under the agreement. This is a routine termination of a sales facility, not a special situation; no strategic implications beyond the company's financing capacity.
